activity.notes: Sheikh Jaber Al-Ahmad Al-Jaber Al-Sabah was proclaimed Emir of Kuwait on 31 December 1977 after the death of Sabah Al-Salem Al-Sabah. He remained Kuwait's ruler until his death on 15 January 2006. ATLAS records the continuous emirate reign, including the 1990-1991 Iraqi occupation, because the occupation displaced the Kuwaiti government but did not constitute Jaber's abdication or replacement as the internationally recognized Emir of Kuwait.
